It identifies full circular pseudospectral levels, a sharp small-noise radius, and the explicit discrete-Volterra constant [2 sin(pi/(4m+2))]^{-1}. This is a natural nonnormal stability invariant and a dimension-independent reduction from arbitrary operator cores to scalar path spectra; it is not a renaming of the known numerical radius or a parameter-substitution exercise.
